# Xenotrix Technologies

> Xenotrix Technologies builds intelligent software, AI systems, automation platforms and digital products for ambitious businesses.

Headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala, India (co-founded in 2025 by **Sanjay S**, **Abi C R**, and **Hari Govind**), Xenotrix Technologies operates globally, delivering high-performance web platforms, Flutter mobile applications, LLM agent orchestrations, and commercial SaaS products.

## Co-Founders & Leadership

- **Sanjay S**: Co-Founder & Lead Software Engineer (AI Integration, Machine Learning & Frontend Systems Architecture)
- **Abi C R**: Co-Founder & Systems Architect (Full-Stack Microservices, Database Engineering & Cloud DevOps)
- **Hari Govind**: Co-Founder & Product & Strategy Lead (Product Operations, Scoping & Digital Growth)

## Flagship Products

- [XenoCRM](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenocrm): Unified business operating system combining CRM sales pipelines, native WhatsApp messaging, automated billing, and AI revenue scoring.
- [Xenotune](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenotune): AI-powered ambient soundscape platform utilizing WebAudio procedural acoustic synthesis for focus, sleep, and circadian sync.
- [XenoBiz (Coming Soon)](https://xenotrix.in/products/xenobiz): Mobile-first business management + CRM + WhatsApp app for small businesses, retail shops, wholesalers, and local service teams combining billing, inventory, payments, and offline-first auto sync.

## Core Capabilities

- [Enterprise Web Development](https://xenotrix.in/services/web-development): High-speed React, Next.js, FastAPI, and Django applications with sub-second latency.
- [Mobile Application Engineering](https://xenotrix.in/services/mobile-development): Cross-platform Flutter apps with native 60 FPS performance and offline sync.
- [Artificial Intelligence & ML Integration](https://xenotrix.in/services/ai-development): Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector database search (Qdrant/Pinecone), and multi-agent AI workflow swarms.
- [Workflow & Business Automation](https://xenotrix.in/services/automation): Official WhatsApp Business API automation, webhook triggers (n8n), and ERP integrations.
- [SaaS Platform Development](https://xenotrix.in/services/saas-development): Multi-tenant architecture, Stripe billing, role-based access control, and usage telemetry.
